title: Term of office of President and members
description: Exceptions to term of office and age limit

content.general_rule: The Central Government may make rules for qualifications, appointment, term of office, etc. of the President and members of the National Commission
content.exception: The President and members shall hold office for a term not exceeding five years and be eligible for re-appointment
conditions: not exceeding five years from the date on which he enters upon his office
not exceeding seventy years for the President
not exceeding sixty-seven years for any other member
